title: Skin in the Game: Antifragility and Optionality at the Expense of Others
coreMove: Reject decisions where the actor keeps upside and transfers the tail risk to someone else.
sourcePressure: This chapter moves into ethics: people should not keep optional upside while exporting downside onto others.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating skin in the game as a macho slogan about taking risks.

sourceAnchors.name: skin in the game
sourceAnchors.detail: the aligning principle that decision-makers should share the risks they impose
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Skin in the game starts where the person choosing cannot send the bill elsewhere.

sourceAnchors.name: optionality at others' expense
sourceAnchors.detail: the source notes name the ethical problem of keeping upside while exporting downside
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The option turns ugly when your win is private and the loss lands on strangers.
